original_text:
Rule 1: A final deliverable memorandum may not be issued unless it is
addressed to the engagement client and identifies the issuing firm. A
memorandum whose address block does not identify both the engagement
client and the issuing firm is forbidden.
Rule 2: A final deliverable memorandum may not be issued unless it
contains a section documenting the items that were reviewed and cleared —
matters that were considered and found not to constitute red flags. A
memorandum containing no cleared-items section is forbidden.
Rule 3: A final deliverable memorandum may not be issued unless it
references the engagement matter. A memorandum that does not reference the
engagement matter is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var addressedToEngagementClient (Bool): True if the final deliverable memorandum's address block identifies the engagement client (i.e., it is addressed to the engagement client); false otherwise.
(declare-const addressedToEngagementClient Bool)
; var identifiesIssuingFirm (Bool): True if the final deliverable memorandum's address block identifies the issuing firm; false otherwise.
(declare-const identifiesIssuingFirm Bool)
; var isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed (Bool): True if the final deliverable memorandum is permitted to be issued under all applicable rules; false if issuance is forbidden.
(declare-const isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed Bool)
; var containsClearedItemsSection (Bool): True if the final deliverable memorandum contains a section documenting the items that were reviewed and cleared (matters considered and found not to constitute red flags); false otherwise.
(declare-const containsClearedItemsSection Bool)
; var referencesEngagementMatter (Bool): True if the final deliverable memorandum references the engagement matter; false otherwise.
(declare-const referencesEngagementMatter Bool)
; Rule NKFSA88XVO92 (if isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed is true, then containsClearedItemsSection is true)
(assert (=> isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed
    containsClearedItemsSection))
; Rule DJGP5XU2NS8T (if isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed is true, then referencesEngagementMatter is true)
(assert (=> isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed
    referencesEngagementMatter))
; Rule OC0IYSQ4BCFD (if isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed is true, then addressedToEngagementClient is true)
(assert (=> isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed
    addressedToEngagementClient))
; Rule KHH8Y2E2EBVX (if isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed is true, then identifiesIssuingFirm is true)
(assert (=> isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed
    identifiesIssuingFirm))
; Rule NC1EGB9ZAH6A (if isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed is false, then at least one of the following 4 statements is true: 1) addressedToEngagementClient is false; 2) identifiesIssuingFirm is false; 3) containsClearedItemsSection is false; 4) referencesEngagementMatter is false)
(assert (=> (not isMemorandumIssuanceAllowed)
    (or (not addressedToEngagementClient)
        (not identifiesIssuingFirm)
        (not containsClearedItemsSection)
        (not referencesEngagementMatter))))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
